        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

def f(g):
    # extract 8-shape bounding box
    rs=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) for x in r if x==8]
    cs=[j for i,r in enumerate(g) for j,x in enumerate(r) if x==8]
    s=[[g[i][j] if g[i][j]==8 else 0 for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1)] for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1)]
    n=sum(x for r in g for x in r if x==4)
    return [row*n for row in s]
